Notebook introduction

This document provides an exhaustive, bit-by-bit technical breakdown of the **Analytical Path Rendering Architecture** in the Retiam WebGPU Engine. It covers SVG decomposition, intermediate quadratic representations, global GPU memory allocations, vertex data layouts, GPU compute encoders, Cardano cubic root solvers, and the dual Stencil-and-Cover Fill & Analytical SDF Stroke pipelines.
1. High-Level Architectural Pipeline
Retiam's `analytical` path pipeline provides **infinite mathematical resolution** and **pixel-perfect anti-aliasing** without geometric tessellation artifacts at extreme zoom levels.

blocks.text: 2. Path Decomposition & Intermediate Quadratic Representation

All vector curves (cubic béziers, arcs, lines, polylines) are parsed and converted into **piecewise quadratic béziers** ($p_0, p_1, p_2$) during decoding in [`PathGeometryUtils.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/utils/PathGeometryUtils.ts).
A. Quadratic Bézier Mathematical Definition
A quadratic bézier curve $B(t)$ with start point $p_0$, control point $p_1$, and end point $p_2$ is parameterized by $t \in [0, 1]$:
B. Cubic-to-Quadratic Subdivision

Cubic béziers $C(t) = (1-t)^3 c_0 + 3(1-t)^2 t c_1 + 3(1-t)t^2 c_2 + t^3 c_3$ are recursively subdivided into quadratic segments such that the maximum Hausdorff distance between the cubic and the approximating quadratics remains within a relative tolerance $\epsilon \le 0.01$.
C. Line & Arc Conversion

items: **Straight Lines (`L`, `Z`, `H`, `V`)**: Formed into quadratic curves with the control point placed collinear along the chord:
**Elliptical Arcs (`A`)**: Decomposed into circular/elliptical quadratic arc splines with angular spans $\le 45^\circ$.

blocks.text: D. Contour Self-Overlap & Hole Resolution

To eliminate even-odd winding artifacts on intricate font glyphs and complex overlapping vector art, [`PathGeometryUtils.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/utils/PathGeometryUtils.ts#L154) executes `removeContainedSameDirectionContours()` using the Shoelace signed area formula and ray-casting containment tests before buffer upload.
3. In-Depth Vertex Data Structure & Point Organization
The vertex data architecture in Retiam's analytical path subsystem operates across two representations:

items: **GPU Storage Buffers**: 5 dedicated global bindless arrays managing control points, contour metadata, stroke bounding strips, arc lengths, and clip quads.

cells: Endpoint of segment 0; start of segment 1

blocks.text: A. Point Indexing & Shared Endpoints
Each quadratic bézier segment $k$ is defined by 3 points:

blocks.tex: \text{Segment } k = \begin{cases} p_0 = \text{points}[2k] & (\text{Start Point}) \\ p_1 = \text{points}[2k + 1] & (\text{Quadratic Control Point}) \\ p_2 = \text{points}[2k + 2] & (\text{End Point / Next Start Point}) \end{cases}

blocks.text: Because consecutive segments within a contour share endpoints ($p_{2k+2} = p_{2(k+1)}$):

items: A contour with $S$ quadratic segments contains **$2S + 1$ control points** ($4S + 2$ 32-bit floats).
Point $0$ is the contour origin $(x_0, y_0)$.
Segment $k$ starts at point index $2k$, has its off-curve control point at $2k + 1$, and ends at $2k + 2$.

blocks.text: B. CPU Contour Array Structure

items: **`vertex_data: number[]`**: Interleaved $[x, y]$ coordinate sequence for all segments:

blocks.tex: [p_{0x}, p_{0y}, \underbrace{p_{1x}, p_{1y}}_{\text{Control Pt}}, \underbrace{p_{2x}, p_{2y}}_{\text{Endpoint}}, \underbrace{p_{3x}, p_{3y}}_{\text{Next Control Pt}}, \underbrace{p_{4x}, p_{4y}}_{\text{Next Endpoint}}, \dots]
\text{indices} = [0, N_0, N_0 + N_1, N_0 + N_1 + N_2, \dots]

blocks.text: Where $N_c$ is the number of coordinate pairs ($2 \times \text{points}$) in contour $c$.

blocks.text: 3. Cardano Constants Injection ($G, H$):

blocks.tex: P = \frac{3 G I - H^2}{3 G^2}, \quad Q = \frac{2 H^3 - 9 G H I + 27 G^2 J}{27 G^3}

blocks.text: The precomputed values $(P, Q)$ are stored directly into `vertex.zw`.
Pass 2: Batched Arc Length Extractor (batchedarclength.wgsl)
Computes high-precision physical arc lengths along each quadratic bézier curve using **Gaussian-Legendre Quadrature**:
Stores 10 cumulative sub-interval lengths per segment into `gpuGlobalArcLengths`, enabling screen-space invariant dash patterns and progressive write animations.

7. Fill Rendering: Stencil-and-Cover Pipeline

blocks.code:
flowchart TD A["1. Stencil chain pass
Triangle fans to origin"] --> C["3. Fill cover pass
Screen quad with stencil"] B["2. Stencil quad pass
Parabolic sign curve"] --> C C --> D["4. Clear stencil pass
Reset stencil bitmask"]

items: **`stencil_chain`**: Flips stencil bits for triangle fans from origin to endpoints. Color write disabled.
**`stencil_quad`**: Evaluates $uv.x^2 - uv.y < 0$ to flip stencil bits for curved lobes between chord lines and true quadratic béziers.
**`fill_cover`**: Renders bounding clip quad testing `stencil != 0`, executing solid/gradient/texture fill fragment shaders.

blocks.text: 10. Summary of Engine Components & File Roles

items: **[`src/engine/components/geometry/PathGeometry.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/components/geometry/PathGeometry.ts)**: Primary analytical geometry component. Manages SVG decoding, contour indexing, and pass configurations.

**[`src/engine/components/renderers/PathRenderer.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/components/renderers/PathRenderer.ts)**: Orchestrates stencil-and-cover fill passes and SDF stroke draw execution.

**[`src/engine/render/allocator/GlobalAnalyticalPipeline.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/allocator/GlobalAnalyticalPipeline.ts)**: Executes compute shaders for bounding envelope encoding and arc length extraction.

**[`src/engine/shaders/includes/path_utils.wgsl`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/shaders/includes/path_utils.wgsl)**: Analytical cubic root solver and signed distance evaluation functions.

**[`src/engine/shaders/includes/stencil_ops.wgsl`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/shaders/includes/stencil_ops.wgsl)**: Stencil bitmask manipulation, Even-Odd rules, and atomic clearing operations.
